name: shared-atx-heading-grammar
body:
The CommonMark ATX heading grammar — a heading of depth 1–6 with up to three leading spaces or tabs — is defined once and used both by the slide and section parser (internal/slide/parse.go, slide's atxHeadingRe) and by the /templates gallery's synthetic example wrapper (internal/server/gallery.go, server.galleryATXHeading), so the gallery deepens exactly the lines the parser treats as headings when it wraps a container template's section example under the synthetic wrapper heading.

AC: the parser's heading recognition and the gallery's heading deepening share one definition.
